name: multimodel-broker
description: Route and delegate tasks to the configured model workers (Codex, DeepSeek, GLM, Gemini, mock) through the Multi-Model Broker's MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to multiple AI model workers
interface.longDescription: Inspect the configured model workers, delegate a task to a selected worker, or fan one call out across several workers and compare the answers. The plugin reuses the Multi-Model Broker app connection: every tool is read-only, spends provider quota, and returns text plus a task id and trace id for auditing.
defaultPrompt: List the available Multimodel Broker workers.
Delegate this task to an appropriate worker.
Run this task across several workers and compare the answers.
